**BLUF:** Tazewell County adopted a policy requiring nonprofits receiving county funds to certify they employ no registered sex offenders and have none on their boards, following a citizen complaint. More than 2,000 early votes have been cast in Tazewell County. In neighboring McDowell County, WV, a man was charged after a search warrant yielded fentanyl, cocaine and firearms; a woman wanted in a Bluefield, WV, shooting was arrested in South Carolina; and a Mongolian delegation visited the Mercer County Sheriff’s Office.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/new-policy-regarding-sex-offenders-and-non-profits-takes-effect-in-tazewell-county/)[[2]](https://www.wvnews.com/news/wvnews/mcdowell-county-man-charged-after-fentanyl-cocaine-and-guns-found/article_062c6fcd-f5f6-4a55-a40f-708e694aa5e6.html)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Tazewell County, VA** — The Tazewell County Board of Supervisors adopted a resolution requiring nonprofits seeking county funding to certify that they do not employ registered sex offenders or have any serving on their boards of directors. The policy responds to a citizen complaint about an organization that had used county facilities and received donations. Chairman Chuck Presley stated, “Taxpayer dollars should be entrusted to organizations that uphold the highest standards of accountability.” The county is revising application forms and notifying affected groups. [OSINT - NEWS] [source](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/new-policy-regarding-sex-offenders-and-non-profits-takes-effect-in-tazewell-county/)[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/new-policy-regarding-sex-offenders-and-non-profits-takes-effect-in-tazewell-county/)

**McDowell County, WV (Premier area)** — Mario Kearse was arrested Monday evening after a search warrant at a home yielded suspected fentanyl, crack cocaine and two handguns. The McDowell County Sheriff’s Office, West Virginia State Police Welch Detachment and Southern Regional Drug and Violent Crime Task Force conducted the investigation. Kearse faces six charges. [OSINT - NEWS] [source](https://www.wvnews.com/news/wvnews/mcdowell-county-man-charged-after-fentanyl-cocaine-and-guns-found/article_062c6fcd-f5f6-4a55-a40f-708e694aa5e6.html)[[2]](https://www.wvnews.com/news/wvnews/mcdowell-county-man-charged-after-fentanyl-cocaine-and-guns-found/article_062c6fcd-f5f6-4a55-a40f-708e694aa5e6.html)

**Bluefield, WV (Mercer County)** — Hallie Graham, wanted in connection with a shots-fired incident at Wild Riders Saloon, was arrested in Myrtle Beach, SC. She faces charges of attempted first-degree murder, three counts of wanton endangerment and one count of malicious assault. She will be extradited to West Virginia. [OSINT - NEWS] [source](https://wvmetronews.com/2026/10/08/south-carolina-police-arrest-woman-wanted-in-bluefield-shooting/)[[3]](https://wvmetronews.com/2026/10/08/south-carolina-police-arrest-woman-wanted-in-bluefield-shooting/)

**Mercer County, WV** — A Mongolian delegation visited the Mercer County Sheriff’s Office to discuss law enforcement practices. [OSINT - NEWS] [source](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/21/mongolian-delegation-visits-mercer-county-sheriffs-office-to-discuss-law-enforcement/)[[4]](https://www.wvva.com/2024/10/17/mongolian-prosecutors-visit-with-judicial-leaders-city-bluefield/)
